description: Four-chamber heart with a controlled cardiac clock (cardiac_clock controlled), four generic chambers and four Mynard valves with a linearised pressure drop (pp_linear), which keeps the model non-stiff (circulatory_autogen's heart vp_wCont_nonstiff split into submodules). In a model, each submodule is named <instance>__<submodule> (e.g. heart__ra), and the host vessels that couple to it are given in the instance's per_submodule_inputs / per_submodule_outputs: typically systemic venous return into ra, pulmonary venous return into la, puv and aov out to the pulmonary and systemic arteries, and the chambers' volumes out to a volume_sum. A chamber's vessel ports sum their flows (chamber Liang2009NoVisco_v02), so an atrium takes any number of inflows (both venae cavae into ra) and a chamber any number of outflows (an ASD shunt from la), with no junction.
